title: Add import resolution pass to map specifiers to file paths
description:
Root cause: All language parsers set resolved_path: None on ImportDecl. The GraphBuilder (builder.rs:141) only creates edges with real node IDs when resolved_path is Some. All edges currently get 'unresolved:' targets which don't match any node — so the web UI graph has 0 edges and blast radius doesn't work.

Fix: Add a post-parse resolution pass in scan_to_json (view.rs) and scan.rs run() that resolves import specifiers to known file paths.

Implementation approach:
1. After collecting all FileAsts, build a HashSet/HashMap of known relative file paths
2. For each FileAst's imports, attempt to resolve the specifier:

For Rust:
- 'mod foo' (specifier: './foo') → check <source_dir>/foo.rs or <source_dir>/foo/mod.rs
- 'use crate::x::y' → map crate:: prefix to crate root, walk module path (x/y.rs or x/y/mod.rs or x/mod.rs)
- 'use super::*' → parent module directory
- External crates (std::, axum::, etc.) → leave unresolved (expected)

For TypeScript/JS:
- './foo' → check foo.ts, foo.tsx, foo.js, foo/index.ts, foo/index.js
- Bare specifiers (npm packages) → leave unresolved

For Python:
- 'from .foo import bar' (specifier starts with '.') → relative resolution
- Absolute imports → leave unresolved

3. Set import.resolved_path = Some(matched_relative_path) when found
4. The existing builder.rs:141 logic will then create proper edges with real node IDs

The resolution should be a standalone function in xray-core (e.g. scanner/resolve.rs or graph/resolve.rs) that takes &mut Vec<FileAst> and the set of known paths.

Also fix scan.rs to use the same resolution pass. Both scan and view commands share this logic.

Acceptance criteria:
- Running 'cargo run -p xray-cli -- scan crates/' produces edges with resolved: true for intra-project imports
- The web UI shows connected edges between nodes
- Blast radius highlights transitive deps when clicking a node
- cargo test passes
- External/stdlib imports remain unresolved (not a regression)
closeReason: Added import resolution pass. Created scanner/resolve.rs with resolve_imports() supporting TypeScript, Rust, Python, and Go. Integrated into both scan.rs and view.rs. All 71 tests pass. Intra-project imports now produce resolved edges in the graph, enabling blast radius to work.

title: Fix Fn mode: backend/frontend response format mismatch
description:
The /api/functions endpoint returns { file, functions, classes } but the frontend expects FunctionInfo[].

Fix approach — adapt the frontend to transform the backend response:

In web/src/main.ts expandFileNode() (around line 234):
1. Parse the response as { file: string, functions: BackendFn[], classes: BackendClass[] }
2. Transform into FunctionInfo[] by:
   - Generating id: fileId + '::' + name
   - Setting file_path from the file field
   - Setting signature: name + '()'
   - Setting kind: 'Function' for functions, 'Class' for classes
   - Mapping calls from CallSite[] to string[] (use callee field)
3. Merge functions and classes into a single FunctionInfo[] array

Backend FunctionDecl shape (from Rust serde):
  { name: string, line_start: number, line_end: number, calls: [{callee, resolved_node_id, line}], is_exported: bool, is_async: bool }
Backend ClassDecl shape:
  { name: string, line_start: number, line_end: number }

Frontend FunctionInfo shape:
  { id: string, file_path: string, name: string, signature: string, kind: 'Function'|'Class', line_start: number, line_end: number, calls: string[] }

After fix: cd web && bun run build
Test: cargo run -p xray-cli -- view crates/, click Fn, click a file node, verify function sub-nodes appear.
closeReason: Fixed Fn mode response format mismatch: transformed backend { file, functions, classes } response into FunctionInfo[] in web/src/main.ts expandFileNode(). Single builder, self-verified, merge_ready sent.
